notes: Subject Tracker: new 'Sort by people' option in the Make card. It puts each result in a subfolder of the output folder: '1 person', or '2+ people' when two people are seen in the picture together. Two people who come one after the other count as 1, and a second box over the same person (an arm, legs) doesn't count. It is off unless you choose it.
Two settings go with it: how long the two must be seen together (3 seconds) and how sure Breezy must be about each of them (60%). Lower values find more pairs, but more often one person seen twice.
